title: Structure nodes visible again; auto-highlights stay aligned
description:
Map Builder was burying structure nodes under opaque PDF sheets (world SVG z-index was too low), and map sheet normalize was healing highlight lines but not structure-node coordinates. Load/persist also stripped page-fraction anchors (nrx/nry), so Auto Highlight rebuilt lines from stale world positions after sheets resized.

Structure markers now always paint above every sheet. Opening/normalizing a map locks and rematerializes both highlights and structure nodes from page fractions, refreshes node markers in the DOM, and Auto Highlight anchors to the active Map page geometry.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building + Plan Sync Auto Highlight on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync, reopen the map, and re-run Auto Highlight if older lines look off. Nodes placed after this update keep stable alignment across sheet scale fixes.
changeLog: Show structure nodes above map sheets (fix world SVG stacking).
Heal structure-node coords when map sheets normalize (was skipped).
Persist and restore structure-node + highlight page fractions (nrx/nry).
Auto Highlight uses active Map page geometry so lines match nodes.
